unsupported: Specialty Wire & Cord Sets operates from Hamden, Connecticut, where it was founded in 1990 by Lee and Lynn Campo.
The company began with the premise that a business could thrive by focusing on short-run production of wire cords, a niche that larger manufacturers often overlook.
All wire is UL-listed or CSA-certified and RoHS compliant.

Known for: No minimum order size; short runs a specialty; Same-day shipping on stocked cords; Quote within one business day; 100% solar-powered manufacturing facility; UL-listed, CSA-certified, and RoHS-compliant products
